newsitem.title: USA: Lawyers give notice of Olympic Finc'l suit.
newsitem.headline: Lawyers give notice of Olympic Finc'l suit.

text.p: The law firms of Weiss & Yourman and Stull, Stull & Brody on Friday announced notice of pendency in a class-action suit filed against Olympic Financial Ltd alleging violations of federal securities laws.
Officials of the Minneapolis-based company said they could not respond because they had not been served with the suit.

The suit accuses the company and certain of its directors and officers with misrepresenting Olympic's loan program and retail repossession and refinancing program and the adequacy of loan loss reserves, the both law firms said in a statement.
The suit was filed March 11 on behalf of shareholders who purchased common stock from Nov. 28, 1994, through March 3, 1997, the law firms said..
Olympic shares were trading at 9-1/2 late Friday afternoon, down 3/8 on the day.
